array_index_store.source:
fn main() -> i64:
    mut values: i64[3] = [10, 20, 30]
    values[1] = 5
    return values[1]

array_index_load.source:
fn main() -> i64:
    values: i64[3] = [10, 20, 30]
    index: i64 = 1
    return values[index]
